notes.title: Small Summer Patch
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Desert map is now a brand new map type.
[*] The old Desert map has been reworked as a Canyon map with some differences in terrain and map objects generation.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed wrong mouse cursor radius when resurrecting a minion that died while overgrown.
[*] Fixed issue in Spooky map where players could spawn in water (hopefully this time for sure).
[*] Fixed bots from bot battles using fractional hp.
[*] Fixed player still being controllable after sinking in the water.
[*] Lightning Rod no longer triggers arcane shields while attached to a player or minion.
[*] Fixed issue with resurrected flame imps not working correctly.
[*] Fixed Chain Lightning not working with Arcane Vision.
[*] Overgrowth no longer shrinks bot enemies in bot battles.
[*] Attempt at fixing a bug where casting a spell using a teammate’s minion did not end your turn if the minion died.
[*] Fixed a camera issue where it would get stuck focusing on the last friendly minion that died.
[/list]

[h2]Balances & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Arcane Vision by adjusting the damage and projectile count values for various spells it can use.
[/list]

Thanks for playing Wizards as always. We'll continue to deliver updates as we work on the game. Please post any feedback in our [url=discord.gg/wizards]Discord[/url] or on the steam forums!!

notes.title: Balance and Bugfix Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Balances & Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased Lich Transformation's drain aura from 3 to 5 damage.
[*] Decreased Den of Darkness's aura damage from 25 to 15.
[*] Fire Bomb now has a 1-turn starting cooldown.
[*] Full Fire now gives you stun immunity to napalm.
[*] Full Arcane's empowered Glyph Ball no longer leaves behind a trail of glyphs.
[*] Decreased the number of extra arrows from full arcane's Arcane Arrows and Arcane Bomb from 2 to 1.
[*] Increased Fireball's base damage from 30 to 40.
[*] Increased Fire Arrow's maximum damage from 45 to 60.
[*] Ice Golem is now a normal summon instead of a projectile-based summon.
[*] Decreased the cooldown of Magic Sapling from 6 turns to 2 turns.
[*] Added the following bonuses for full Underdark: Dark Arrows shoot 1 extra arrow. Remove the cooldown for Resurrect.
[*] Reaper now has a base minimum of 50 HP.
[*] Added new spell for Dark Knight, Fear: cause all nearby entities to jump away from the caster. Does not work on frozen, stunned, and towered entities.
[*] Full Overlight's extra sky rays now deal 25 damage instead of 50.
[*] Decreased Guardian Angel's HP from 60 to 50.
[*] Made the following changes to Arcane Portal: The targeted portal can now overlap entities, but not terrain. The portal that spawns above you can no longer overlap entities.
[*] Piety now deals normal damage instead of directly changing a player's HP when used on players with HP higher than the average. In other words, it is now affected by Protection Shield, Stone Skin, towers, etc.
[*] (Temporary) Mushrooms are removed when their owner dies. They stop working when the owner dies in the first place, which is a bug that will be fixed in a future patch.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Overlight and Underdark spells are no longer missing in Random Spells mode.
[*] Flying entities no longer get stuck in the map corners when teleported using Arcane Portal.
[*] Blink is no longer disabled when you cast Angel Transformation.
[*] Fixed wrong number in Light Castle's description.
[*] Updated Ice Tower's description.
[*] Fixed Mega Clam and Mega Waterball not working properly if used by a Reaper minion.
[*] HP draining no longer carries over if you died by self-damage and revived with a soul jar.
[*] Fixed the glowing effect for full underdark's icon not disappearing when the player's soul jar sinks.
[*] Fixed Aura of Decay preventing terrain from being created through effects such as empowered acorns and Vine Bridge.
[*] Fixed wrong order of operations for knockback on several spells (like Shock Bomb), causing momentum to be preserved if they triggered Soul Jar's effect or Substitution.
[*] You can no longer blink into the water and get stuck.
[*] Necro'd minions no longer get permanently frozen if they were previously frozen.
[*] Phoenix eggs no longer trigger Aura of Decay.
[*] Fixed necro'd flame imps not dealing the correct amount of damage.
[*] Fixed flame imps not being counted properly sometimes when sacrificed using Reaper or Dark Defences.
[*] Removed knockback resistance on Reaper when using Rocket Jump.
[*] Arcane Shield is no longer triggered by your own projectiles if they're moving away from you.
[*] Fixed Imp Explosion not killing the minion that cast it if protected by a Guardian Angel.
[*] Fixed bug where Arcane Shield and Shock Shield are removed if your last minion died.
[*] Fixed bug with arcane glyphs completely removing the light projectile that summons a Holy Knight, preventing it from spawning.
[*] Mounting a minion no longer removes any mushrooms attached to you.
[*] Fixed the poison visual effect affecting objects besides the player.
[*] Fixed bug where mushrooms would detach from entities if they were too close to each other after being hit by Overgrowth.
[*] Comet no longer ignores Tree of Life's terrain strengthening effect.
[*] Fixed mushrooms and lightning rod not detaching from a player that died and turned into a ghost.
[/list]

notes.title: Full Book Bonuses, Steam Achievements, Bug Fixes and more!
notes.notes:
This update is a really big one! Here is a full list of all the patch notes.

This patch will be going live at 8 PM PST. (In about 3 hours from the posting of this announcement)

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Teams can now be selected before the match starts in the lobby.
[*]  Greatly increased the range of Phoenix's Fire Breath absorption.
[*]  Nerfed Rain of Fire's damage from 15 to 10 per fireball.
[*]  Buffed Comet's base damage to 90, and it now digs slightly into terrain before exploding.
[*]  Changed Mega Boulder to 6 bounces x 20 damage per bounce.
[*]  Nerfed Mud Blast's initial damage from 30 to 10.
[*]  Removed the sandbox dummy's knockback resistance.
[*]  Buffed Tree of Life's hp from 35 to 50.
[*]  Increased snowflake count for Snowflake Blast from 16 to 20.
[*]  Fissure will now spawn a minimum of 6 Rock Scatter projectiles on its 2nd turn.
[*]  Increased the range of the toxic fumes for mushrooms.
[*]  Storm Titan's thunderstorm now no longer activates immediately after the titan is summoned.
[*]  Branch of Yggdrasil has been replaced by a new spell, Summon Ent, and its effects have been moved and modified into buffs for Full Nature (see Full Book Bonuses section).
[*]  Added new minion spell Vine Bridge to the Ent minion.
[*]  Added a visual effect to Ice Golem's aura.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Fixed wrong radius being used for the cursor after sinking while overgrown.
[*]  Fixed wrong order of operations for if an entity with Substitute set up is hit by a Spore Ball.
[*]  Clams now have a cap of 7 damaging bounces to prevent the infinite bounce bug.
[*]  Arcane damage no longer hurts friendly minions.
[*]  Fixed minion summoning radius being too small when overgrown.
[*]  Fixed wrong radius values being used for most minion spells with a summoning range.
[*]  Fixed lightning rod sinking through entities if on an entity that is mounted on a minion.
[*]  Flying minions no longer lose their collision after not moving for a long time and then moving vertically only.
[*]  Updated visual indicators for Fissure, Whirlpool, and Whale, to match Volcano's indicator.
[*]  Fixed players continuing to move if pressing tab to open chat while still pressing left/right.
[*]  Fixed Arcane Portals still being allowed to spawn on towered players.
[*]  Added missing stun immunity for Rock Golem.
[/list]

[h2][b]FULL BOOK BONUSES[/b][/h2]
If you have all spells from a spellbook equipped, you get a new button when joining a match to activate full book bonuses. Activating the bonuses costs 50 HP and gives you various buffs and effects specific to each book.

[h3]Arcane[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Arcane Arrows and Arcane Bomb spawn 2 extra arrows.
[*]  Arcane Glyphs spawn an extra outer ring of glyphs.
[*]  Glyph Ball leaves behind a trail of glyphs.
[*]  On activation, you and all your current minions gain the following passive: at the start of your turn, shoot an arcane arrow towards the nearest enemy.
[/list]

[h3]Fire[/h3]
[list]
[*]  The Phoenix's egg form becomes permanently unbreakable.
[*]  Increase the explosion radius of all your explosive fire spells by 50%.
[/list]

[h3]Earth[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Gain permanent Stone Skin (with 2 instead of 5 damage reduction), and replace the Stone Skin spell with Rollout.
[*]  Mud rock projectiles create more terrain.
[/list]

[h3]Water[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Gain permanent Water Skin, and replace the Water Skin spell with Dive.
[*]  Waterball and Water Jet spawn 10 extra droplets.
[*]  Spring Shower spawns 10 extra droplets per turn.
[*]  Whirlpool's height is increased.
[/list]

[h3]Frost[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Gain immunity to being frozen.
[*]  Ice Ring becomes a targetable spell.
[*]  Ice Golem spawns a Frost Imp on death.
[*]  Convert Comet into Mini Comet: drop a small comet that's half the size and damage of Comet, but with a 2turn cooldown and more digging.
[/list]

[h3]Storm[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Lightning Bolt and Lightning Bomb shoot 2 extra bolts.
[*]  All your Chain Lightning projectiles bounce an extra 8 times.
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]Nature[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Acorns create terrain around where they spawn.
[*]  Overgrowth makes entities even larger.
[*]  On activation, all your existing mushrooms gain the following passive: at the start of your turn, shoot a spore ball towards the nearest enemy.
[/list]

notes.title: Nature Book Update, Bug Fixes and more!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for waiting. The next patch is finally here! Let us know what you think in Discord or on our Steam boards ːsteamhappyː

The patch will drop at 3:15PM PST today.

[h3]Cosmetics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Beta Hat and Patreon Supporter Wand to the game. If you played a few games during the beta you will receive the hat. If you supported us on Patreon you will also receive the Supporter Wand. ❤️
[*] Added Mushroom Costume which drops like other items.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added player counts to the mode select menu
[*] Replaced Leaf Arrow and Leaf Storm with new spells Spore Ball and Spore Bomb.
[*] Spores deal damage on impact and spawn fungus (mushrooms).
[*] Fungus deals damage to anyone nearby at the start of your turn, every turn, and they cannot be destroyed except by sinking.
[*] Replaced Nature's Touch with new minion Mantrap: a mountable minion, but every turn it deals 30 damage to whoever is mounted on it. Only entities smaller enough than the mantrap can mount it. The mantrap is also unable to jump.
[*] New minion spell Vine Tunnel: tunnel through terrain and teleport to where the spell leaves terrain.
[*] The sandbox dummy now has several of the Tier 3 spells equipped.
[*] Enabled camera focus by pressing C for missiles, bombs, and environment objects (clouds, whirlpool, volcano, etc).
[*] Changed Water Troll's HP to 60.
[*] The Water Troll and Whale now won't have Waterball unless you have it equipped yourself.
[*] The Storm Wisp now won't have Blink unless you have it equipped yourself.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where a mountable minion can steal a player from another mountable minion, causing the minion stolen from to become unmountable.
[*] Updated Hailstorm's icon.
[*] Fixed camera shaking bug when zoomed all the way out in some maps.
[*] Lightning bolts no longer have a small limited range.
[*] Removed the outdated ice shield background on the Ice Golem.
[*] Fixed the black texture bug in the map editor.
[/list]

notes.title: Storm Graphical Update and More
notes.notes:
This is a small patch to update storm graphics and fix some bugs in the game. This patch also has a few minor balance changes which should improve some degenerative gameplay. Regarding nature, we are still unhappy with how it turned out and will be releasing a rework for the book next. The rework will change a bunch of the spells as well as add minions into the book.

We know content has been a little slow. To help this we'll be releasing some fun temporary gamemodes in the next few days. We plan to rotate them in and out to see what players enjoy and to keep them fresh. Stay tuned for more news on the rotating gamemodes. If you have any ideas for a rotating gamemode let us know!

[b][u]This patch will be dropping at 1PM PST (about 30 minutes after this announcement goes live).[/u][/b]

[h3]Storm Book[/h3]
[list]
[*] Most visual assets have been finished. We still would like to add some custom explosion animations but we are happy with what we have for now.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blink can no longer be used while in a tower
[*] Blink now has a 2-turn cooldown
[*] Chain Lightning now bounces 14 times
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed napalm not triggering acorns
[*] The water lord's version of Waterball now has the right description
[*] Bombs now have the same weight as normal projectiles
[*] Fixed substitute triggering during your turn
[/list]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added keybind setting for switching minions
[/list]

notes.title: Storm Spellbook + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you to @everyone for your patience. Today's patch will drop at 8:00 PM PST (about 3 hours from time of posting).

Login Servers will go down at 8:00 PM PST for about 30 minutes in preparation for the patch.

This patch will mark a small break in-between new spell books. We will be using the next update(s) to begin removing any rough edges currently in the game. We will continue to incorporate feedback into our development! Keep posting your thoughts, comments and ideas in the appropriate channels!
[i][b]Storm[/b][/i]

The storm spellbook will be making its debut. Storm spell art assets are currently work-in-progress.

[i][b]Nature[/b][/i]

Nature fell flat a little on release. We've adjusted many of its cooldowns to better match the power level of the spells. Damage has been added to a few of its spells and increased on ones that already dealt damage. Nature's gameplay will continue to be a work-in-progress, stay tuned for more info regarding changes to the nature spells.

[list]
[*] Natures Touch and Enchanted Sapling have swapped places in the spellbook.
[*] Empowered Acorn Bomb now creates a ring of terrain when it explodes
[*] Empowered Mega Acorn Bomb creates a large amount of terrain when it explodes.
[*] Acorns deal 10 damage up from 5.
[*] Acorn Bomb deals 10 damage upon explosion.
[*] Vine Whip deals 50 damage up from 25.
[*] Leaf Shoot is now a quick cast with 5 max casts.
[*] Empowered Overgrowth now greatly increases the size of things hit.
[*] Leaf Storm has been completely reworked. It now causes bombs and missiles inside it to explode early.
[*] Tree of Life now has a nearby aura that reduces the size of nearby projectiles significantly. Damage dealt within this aura is halved. Tree of Life HP has been upped to 50.
[*] Branch of Yggdrasil now has a starting cooldown of 5 turns.
[/list]

[i][b]Balance[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Arcane Vortex now has Arcane Gate.
[*] 
[/list]
[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed ice minions duplicating
[*] Fixed ice ring missing the bottom iceball
[*] Weather objects can no longer be moved around with Arcane Portal (you wish!)
[*] Fixed players looking off-center in some towers
[*] Substitute can no longer be cast in terrain
[/list]

[i][b]Visual Changes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Napalm ripple effect has been made more apparent
[/list]

notes.title: Nature Book Release + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for your patience. Today's patch will drop at 5:30 PM PST.

Login Servers will go down at 5:30 PM PST for about 20 minutes in preparation for the patch.

Next week we hope to have another spell book coming out as well. Can you guess which one?

[i][b]! Nature ![/b][/i]
The nature spellbook will be making its debut. It contains 12 new spells, each very different from anything currently in the game.
Nature spell icons and object assets are work-in-progress. We plan to update them next week.

[i][b]Balance[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Buffed fissure to reach higher and shoot more scatter rocks.
[*] Whirlpool starting cooldown changed to 3 from 4.
[*] Fissure starting cooldown changed from 3 to 5.
[*] Firework now shoots out 2 napalm if it hits ground early.
[*] Phoenix now revives with 30 hp up from 15.
[*] Ice arrow now has a cooldown of 2 turns and no limit to how many times it can be cast.
[*] Increased water jet knockback.
[*] Added a speed limit to how fast flying minions can move.
[*] Rock Golem now rolls slower when frozen.
[*] Ice shards now scatter a little less.
[/list]

[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Napalm that is on the ground is no longer affected by ice castle.
[*] Fixed aerial aiming being incorrect sometimes.
[*] Fixed deluge description being incorrect.
[*] Rolling snowball now properly sinks flying minions.
[*] Napalm bomb now correctly spawns 20 napalm as the tooltip suggested.
[*] Fixed spell book menu sometimes having duplicate books.
[/list]

We will be releasing a larger content patch soon. Stay tuned for more.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
We hope you had a nice new years!

Wizards will be releasing under Early Access on January 15th.

The game will launch with five spell books: Arcane, Fire, Water, Earth and Frost.
There will also be normal matchmade games and custom lobbies. Ranked will come out shortly after launch. We'll be answering questions in our Steam discussion boards and also on our [url=discord.gg/wizards]Discord[/url].

Thank you to all those who supported us throughout our alpha and beta.
